user.title: Kuehlgeraet Cockpit
user.description: Set up the open rule engine for a refrigeration appliance. Selectable entities are grouped by purpose: switch targets, measurement sources, price sources, and additional actions.

data.failsafe_on: Failsafe: turn on when temperature is missing

data_description.target_entity: All selected targets are switched with the main service. The first entity provides the on/off state and minimum runtime age.
data_description.turn_on_service: Service called for all targets when turning on, for example homeassistant.turn_on or switch.turn_on.
data_description.turn_off_service: Service called for all targets when turning off, for example homeassistant.turn_off or switch.turn_off.
data_description.turn_on_action_entities: Simple additional entities such as script.*, scene.*, or input_boolean.* started via homeassistant.turn_on after turning on.
data_description.turn_off_action_entities: Simple additional entities such as script.*, scene.*, or input_boolean.* started via homeassistant.turn_on after turning off.
data_description.turn_on_actions: Full Home Assistant action sequence for multiple services after turning on.
data_description.turn_off_actions: Full Home Assistant action sequence for multiple services after turning off.
data_description.temperature_entity: Numeric entity for the current refrigeration temperature.
data_description.power_entity: Optional numeric entity for the current compressor power draw.
data_description.price_entity: Optional numeric entity for the current electricity price.
data_description.price_min_entity: Optional numeric entity for the lowest comparison price.
data_description.price_max_entity: Optional numeric entity for the highest comparison price.
data_description.cheap_entity: Optional boolean entity. On means cheap, off means expensive when no price min/max range is used.

error.invalid_service: Use domain.service format, for example homeassistant.turn_on.
